title: Stop waiting for an open door. God is about to BUILD one just for you. 🔥
paragraphs: Stop waiting for an open door. God is about to BUILD one just for you. 🔥

We get stuck looking for the easy path, but the Gospel Warrior knows that sometimes, the way forward doesn't exist yet. Your faith isn't just for walking through opportunities; it's for believing God can create them from absolutely nothing.
The obstacle you're facing isn't a dead end. It's the construction site for your greatest miracle. Keep pushing. The door is being forged in the fire. ⚔️
📖 "See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland." – Isaiah 43:19 (NIV)
👇 Drop a "🔥" if you're ready to walk through the door God is building for you!
👉 Follow me for daily spiritual armor and motivation to fight the good fight!
